title: Why flexible and adaptive leadership is essential.
why_read: Broad synthesis differentiates adaptive/flexible leadership conceptions, research streams and limitations. Strongest observed article uptake after excluding the misclassified Practice book.
evidence_scope: APA publisher search-index abstract and official issue contents; direct DOI fetch robots-denied
seminal_status: provisional candidate / branch reading; not definitive historical ranking

title: Adaptive leadership theory: Leading and following as a complex adaptive process
why_read: Develops an interactional account of recurring leader/follower exchanges, identities and structures; distinct theoretical route and substantial observed uptake. Publisher abstract/previews establish conceptual content, not firsthistoricalpriority.
seminal_status: provisional candidate / branch reading; not definitive historical ranking

title: Adaptive Leadership: When Change Is Not Enough (Part One)
authors: Jerry Glover; Harris L. Friedman; G Jones
why_read: Primary firstarticleabstract confirms a2002conceptual formulation using Piaget assimilation/accommodation. Earlier than most shortlistedworks, but not proof of universalfounding. Distinct from the Heifetz and DeRue formulations.
evidence_scope: Primary journal article copy hosted by an author interest group; cover and first-article abstract inspected, not the complete40-page packet
seminal_status: provisional candidate / branch reading; not definitive historical ranking

title: Applying adaptive leadership to successful change initiatives in academia
authors: Linda M. Randall; Lori A. Coakley
why_read: Two academic change cases apply Heifetz and propose a stakeholder process; early application with visible local uptake. Cases do not establish causal effectiveness.
evidence_scope: Publisher DOI retrieval failed. Frozen corpus abstract remains the available substantive source; external third-party summaries were not accepted as primary evidence.
seminal_status: provisional candidate / branch reading; not definitive historical ranking
